description: This file is a controller for managing 'other' type extensions in the OpenCart admin panel. It provides methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling extensions, handling permissions, and dynamically loading related components.

classes.name: Other
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'other' extensions in OpenCart admin panel, including listing available extensions, and handling their installation and removal.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the list of 'other' extensions by invoking getList and setting the output response.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and prepares the list of available and installed 'other' extensions for display in the admin interface.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a selected 'other' extension, including permission checks, file existence verification, and registering necessary components.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a selected 'other' extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
